summary: Implemented the rich_measure and VerticalCenter feature. Changes: rich/tree.py adds an iterative Tree.__rich_measure__ (explicit stack, level counter, four cells of indent per level) and imports Measurement; rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, constrains Align rendering to the measured maximum (or the smaller of that and an explicit width), and adds the public VerticalCenter class with render, measure and repr; rich/console.py sets justify="default" in print's render options while still passing justify into _collect_renderables; CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 unreleased with an Added section; tests/test_align.py and tests/test_tree.py gained the requested tests. Nothing was run, per the instructions, so the test suite is unverified. Nothing was committed. Next step: run pytest on tests/test_align.py and tests/test_tree.py, then the full suite, paying attention to the existing Align width and fit tests.
